name: RoboWrite
tagline: Write SEO content briefs using keyword research, competitor research and your brand voice.
description: Plan GEO content briefs for visibility in AI answers. Bring audience profiles and relevant sources from your knowledge library into each brief, then review the brief or recover saved Markdown drafts. Workspace access requires OAuth. Cline CLI 3.0.75 discovers the tools but can report authorization before sign-in completes.

install.notes: For an existing connection, open `cline mcp` and choose Authorize OAuth. If you use Edit server, re-enter the server URL and any configured public OAuth client ID. Leaving the ID blank removes it. A noninteractive reinstall can also replace these settings. Protected workspace access is still awaiting verification in a released Cline client.
